page.layout: One printed page (page 161) with a running head at the top. Below the head: a heading line, then a full-width synopsis diagram made of braces, with label boxes and their level numbers. Below the diagram: one closing line of running text and the gathering signature at the foot. Left margin: edge of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

main_text.head: Synopsis totius Epistolæ talis est:
main_text.l: Doctrinalis fidei: in qua confirmat Ephesios: idque ex parte
particulari enumeratione à v.4 ad finem
Speciali applicatione ad Ephesios, & amplificatione per comparationem miserrimi status prioris. cap.2.
Adhortatione ad sanctitatem vitae: ubi est huius partis
Tractatio: in enumeratione officium per tinentiùm ad
Omnes homines, cap.4. à v.2. vsq; ad finem capitis, & c.5. vsque ad v.22.
mariti & uxoris, àv 22. c. 5. ad finem;
reliquorum in œconomia, cap.6. vsque ad v.10.
Conclusio: de Panoplia Dei induenda, à v.10.vsque ad 21.
main_text.p: Conclusionem, in Apostolica & pia salutatione. à v. 21. ad finem epistolæ.

page.notes: The diagram's brace levels and the nesting of the labels are read from the drawing and are approximate. The labels "cap.1.", "c.3." (beside the Pathemata/Mathemata brace), "c.4." and "c.5." beside the braces are printed labels; I have kept their text inside the nearest box rather than as separate lines, so their exact placement may differ from the scan. The numerals "161" and "R. iij," are read from the scan. The left edge of the neighbouring page (vertical running text, "epistola ad Ephesios" and tiny notes) is not part of this page and is left out.
